Definition: a descendant of the third degree, i.e. great grandchild
BiblicalUsage: Joseph sees his great-grandchildren on his knees, and the law repeats that God visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third generation. The word is the third degree of a family, close enough to touch and far enough to inherit.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the third generation is God's way of saying that families are bound together for good and for ill. I hold that the same law which visits iniquity also shows mercy to thousands, and I would rather my grandchildren inherit the mercy.
